newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Omni offers 54 mln IPO shares at S$0.45 each.
newsitem.headline: Omni offers 54 mln IPO shares at S$0.45 each.

text.p: Electronics mould-maker Omni Industries Ltd said on Tuesday it was offering a total of 54 million shares at Singapore $0.45 each for a listing on Singapore's second board, SESDAQ.
Omni Industries said in a statement 40.5 million shares would be offered to the public and the balance of 13.5 million shares would be placed out privately.
The offer represented 15.3 percent of the company's enlarged issued capital of 353.5 million shares.

The company said it expected to raise net proceeds of about S$22.9 million to be used to set up a factory in China, to buy new machinery and equipment and to repay bank borrowings of about S$12 million. About 3.9 million would be used for additional working capital, it said.
The share invitation opens on February 19 and closes on March 3. Trading on a when-issued-basis begins on March 5.
The shares will be traded in board lots of 1,000 each.
